description: Create a new table in the specified data model.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the data model where the table will be created.

table_name.description: Name of the table to create.

database_name.description: Name of the data source database. If not provided, inferred from the data model's dataset.

schema_name.description: Name of the data source schema. If not provided, inferred from the data model's dataset.

dataset_id.description: ID of the dataset where the table will be created. If not provided, inferred from the data model (requires a single dataset).

import_query.description: SQL statement used as a custom import query. Defaults to ``None``.

description.description: Description for the table. Defaults to an empty string.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the table. Defaults to ``None``.

build_behavior_config.description: Build behavior configuration applied for EXTRACT models. Supported fields: ``mode`` (one of ``"replace"``, ``"replace_changes"``, ``"append"``, ``"increment"``) and, when ``mode`` is ``"increment"``, ``column_name`` (the incremental column).

examples.user_query: Create a new table named 'sales_summary' in the 'ecommerce_data' data model.
examples.notes: This call creates a new table named 'sales_summary' in the 'ecommerce_data' data model, inferring the database, schema, and dataset from the data model.

examples.user_query: Add a table named 'customer_orders' to the 'retail_analytics' data model using a custom SQL query.
examples.notes: This call creates a table named 'customer_orders' in the 'retail_analytics' data model, using a custom SQL query to filter data from the source.

examples.user_query: Create a table named 'daily_transactions' in the 'finance_data' data model with incremental build behavior.
examples.notes: This call creates a table named 'daily_transactions' in the 'finance_data' data model and configures it for incremental builds based on the 'transaction_date' column.

description: Deploy (build or publish) the specified data model based on its type.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the data model to deploy.

build_type.description: Build strategy for extract models. Omit for live/publish.

row_limit.description: Maximum number of rows to process for EXTRACT builds. Defaults to ``0`` (no limit). Ignored for LIVE models.

schema_origin.description: Schema source for EXTRACT builds. One of ``"latest"`` (schema as seen in the Data page, the default) or ``"running"`` (last successfully built version). Ignored for LIVE models.

examples.user_query: How can I fully rebuild the 'Sales_Analytics' data model?

examples.user_query: I want to incrementally build the 'Marketing_Performance' data model with a row limit of 100,000. How can I do that?
examples.notes: This call performs an incremental build of the 'Marketing_Performance' data model, processing up to 100,000 rows per table. This is ideal for large datasets where a full rebuild is unnecessary.

examples.user_query: Can I deploy the 'Customer_Insights' data model using the latest schema?
examples.notes: This call deploys the 'Customer_Insights' data model using the latest schema configuration. It ensures the model reflects the most recent changes made in the Data page.

description: Set up a data model end to end using an existing connection.

datamodel_type.description: Type of the data model. Should be either ``"extract"`` (for Elasticube) or ``"live"`` (for Live).

connection_name.description: Name of the connection to use.

database_name.description: Name of the data source database.

schema_name.description: Name of the data source schema.

tables.description: List of tables to add. For 'live' models, build_behavior_config is ignored. For 'extract' models, set build_behavior_config as needed.

database_name.description: Optional override of the table's database. Defaults to top-level database_name if omitted.

schema_name.description: Optional override of the table's schema. Defaults to top-level schema_name if omitted.

table_name.description: Physical table name to add, or a logical name when using import_query.

import_query.description: Optional custom SQL (executed as-is). Use fully-qualified tables: schema.table (Databricks: `schema`.`table`).

tags.description: Optional list of tags for the table.

build_behavior_config.description: Extract models only; omit for 'live'. For 'increment' mode, column_name is required.

mode.description: Table build behavior for extract models.

dataset_name.description: Name of the dataset. Defaults to the schema name if not provided.
